geo_spot_check.population: valid CONSISTENT cases, stages G0-G4 (G5 K-sweep duplicates and CF counterfactuals excluded)

selection_rules.closest_to_threshold: argmin over |d| of distance to the nearest GEO class boundary (|d| = 0.02, 0.10, 0.25), G0 excluded

geo_spot_check.escalation_rule: Escalate to the full GEO primary grid if ANY selected case changes class_full, OR |post-pre change of d| >= 0.5 x its pre-F1 threshold margin, OR |post-pre change of full_f_perp| >= 0.01 absolute.

d2_primary: 9 geometries x {GC, GM}, 5 nrad, angular semantics, dense rows; classes cls (relative gain) and abs_cls recomputed with the D2 rules; pre = same script run at the entering HEAD

gates.local_gradient: relative error of analytic vs central-FD (production acceleration) <= 1e-6 on the FD plateau at every well-defined point; exact zero for K=0, umbra interior, NO_SHADOW illumination term
gates.stm: max best-resolved relative error over 6 STM state columns <= 1e-6 on the HARDEN D05 4-orbit case (or at a demonstrated oracle floor with a tolerance-convergence study)
gates.k_sensitivity: max best-resolved relative error of S_K vs K re-propagation <= 1e-6, or at a demonstrated floor with step and tolerance studies
gates.old_approximation_negative_control: old (gradient-omitting) model must fail the same oracle by >= 10x more than the new model on the penumbra-rich case
gates.measurement_derivatives: post-F1 errors must not exceed the HARDEN artifact values (phase17_harden_derivatives.json) by more than 2x on any column; state-column best errors <= 1e-5, K <= 1e-3 (existing HARDEN bounds)
gates.materiality: class change of any D2 primary cell => SCIENTIFIC_CLASSIFICATION_CHANGED; value change beyond the authoritative status precision (4-6 significant digits) with classes preserved => NUMERICAL_BASELINES_UPDATED_CLASSES_PRESERVED
